# 1. Setup

# 2. Required libraries

```{r libraries, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(kableExtra)
```

# 3. Helper functions

```{r CI}
calculate_proportion_ci <- function(n, x, confidence_level = 0.95) {
  # Calculate observed proportion
  p <- x / n
  
  # Calculate z-score for the confidence level
  z <- qnorm((1 + confidence_level) / 2)
  
  # Calculate margin of error
  margin_of_error <- z * sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n)
  
  # Calculate the confidence interval
  lower_bound <- max(0, p - margin_of_error)
  upper_bound <- min(1, p + margin_of_error)
  
  # Return lower and upper bounds
  return(list(lower_bound = lower_bound, upper_bound = upper_bound))
}
```


```{r index_data}
sensor_index <- read_csv("./shiny/processed_sens_data/index/global_sensor_index.csv")
```

# 5. Clean, merge, typeset

```{r data_cleanup}
# Append sensor_index to instrument_index
# Only join good sensors (bad_sens = N) and overall roi data
merged_data <- instrument_index %>%
  filter(roi == "overall") %>%
  left_join(sensor_index %>% 
              filter(bad_sens == "N") %>%
              select(file, sensor, deployment_id, treatment, 
                     passage_duration.mm.ss., ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., 
                     nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss.), 
            by = "file") %>%
  # Setup data types
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, 
                      levels = c("treatment_1", "treatment_2", "treatment_3", "treatment_4"),
                      labels = c("Treatment 1", "Treatment 2", "Treatment 3", "Treatment 4")),
    roi = factor(roi,
                 levels = c("overall", "roi1_sens_ingress", "roi2_inflow_passage", 
                           "roi3_prenadir", "roi4_nadir", "roi5_postnadir", 
                           "roi6_outflow_passage", "roi7_sens_outgress"),
                 labels = c("Overall", "ROI 1", "ROI 2", "ROI 3", "ROI 4", 
                           "ROI 5", "ROI 6", "ROI 7")),
    acc_strike = factor(acc_strike,
                       levels = c("N", "Y"),
                       labels = c("No blade strike", "Blade strike")),
    # Convert event columns to integers
    acc_event_95g = as.integer(acc_event_95g),
    acc_event_200g = as.integer(acc_event_200g),
    acc_event_400g = as.integer(acc_event_400g),
    acc_shear = as.integer(acc_shear),
    acc_collision = as.integer(acc_collision)
  )

# Get all ROI data with proper factors
all_roi_data <- instrument_index %>%
  left_join(sensor_index %>% 
              filter(bad_sens == "N") %>%
              select(file, sensor, deployment_id, treatment), 
            by = "file") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, 
                      levels = c("treatment_1", "treatment_2", "treatment_3", "treatment_4"),
                      labels = c("Treatment 1", "Treatment 2", "Treatment 3", "Treatment 4")),
    roi = factor(roi,
                 levels = c("overall", "roi1_sens_ingress", "roi2_inflow_passage", 
                           "roi3_prenadir", "roi4_nadir", "roi5_postnadir", 
                           "roi6_outflow_passage", "roi7_sens_outgress"),
                 labels = c("Overall", "ROI 1", "ROI 2", "ROI 3", "ROI 4", 
                           "ROI 5", "ROI 6", "ROI 7")),
    # Convert event columns to integers
    acc_event_95g = as.integer(acc_event_95g),
    acc_event_200g = as.integer(acc_event_200g),
    acc_event_400g = as.integer(acc_event_400g),
    acc_shear = as.integer(acc_shear),
    acc_collision = as.integer(acc_collision)
  )
```

# 6. Utility rate

```{r data-quality}
utility_rate <- sensor_index %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    total_files = n(),
    total_good = sum(bad_sens == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_bad = sum(bad_sens == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    utility_rate_pct = round((total_good / total_files) * 100, 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Add overall row
  bind_rows(
    sensor_index %>%
      summarise(
        treatment = "Overall",
        total_files = n(),
        total_good = sum(bad_sens == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
        total_bad = sum(bad_sens == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
        utility_rate_pct = round((total_good / total_files) * 100, 1)
      )
  )

kable(utility_rate, 
      col.names = c("Treatment", "Total Files", "Good", "Bad", "Utility Rate (%)"),
      caption = "Sensor Utility Rate by Treatment") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, 
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

# 7. Collision and blade strike assessment

```{r collision_sum}
# Create summary statistics table for impact events by ROI
collision_summary <- all_roi_data %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sensors = n(),
    event_95g = sum(acc_event_95g, na.rm = TRUE),
    event_200g = sum(acc_event_200g, na.rm = TRUE),
    event_400g = sum(acc_event_400g, na.rm = TRUE),
    shear_n = sum(acc_shear, na.rm = TRUE),
    collision_n = sum(acc_collision, na.rm = TRUE),
    blade_strike_n = ifelse(roi == "Overall", 
                           sum(acc_strike == "Blade strike", na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Calculate probabilities and confidence intervals
  mutate(
    # Shear probability and CI
    shear_prob = shear_n / n_sensors,
    shear_ci = map2(n_sensors, shear_n, ~calculate_proportion_ci(.x, .y)),
    shear_prob_ci = map_chr(shear_ci, ~paste0(round(.x$lower_bound, 3), "-", round(.x$upper_bound, 3))),
    
    # Collision probability and CI
    collision_prob = collision_n / n_sensors,
    collision_ci = map2(n_sensors, collision_n, ~calculate_proportion_ci(.x, .y)),
    collision_prob_ci = map_chr(collision_ci, ~paste0(round(.x$lower_bound, 3), "-", round(.x$upper_bound, 3))),
    
    # Blade strike probability and CI (only for Overall)
    blade_strike_prob = ifelse(!is.na(blade_strike_n), blade_strike_n / n_sensors, NA),
    blade_strike_ci = ifelse(!is.na(blade_strike_n), 
                            map2(n_sensors, blade_strike_n, ~calculate_proportion_ci(.x, .y)),
                            list(NA)),
    blade_strike_prob_ci = ifelse(!is.na(blade_strike_n),
                                 map_chr(blade_strike_ci, ~paste0(round(.x$lower_bound, 3), "-", round(.x$upper_bound, 3))),
                                 NA)
  ) %>%
  select(-shear_ci, -collision_ci, -blade_strike_ci)

# Format table with gt
collision_summary %>%
  select(roi, event_95g, event_200g, event_400g, 
         shear_n, shear_prob, shear_prob_ci,
         collision_n, collision_prob, collision_prob_ci,
         blade_strike_n, blade_strike_prob, blade_strike_prob_ci) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Impact Event Summary by ROI") %>%
  cols_label(
    roi = "ROI",
    event_95g = "≥95g Events",
    event_200g = "≥200g Events", 
    event_400g = "≥400g Events",
    shear_n = "Shear (n)",
    shear_prob = "Shear Prob",
    shear_prob_ci = "Shear 95% CI",
    collision_n = "Collision (n)",
    collision_prob = "Collision Prob", 
    collision_prob_ci = "Collision 95% CI",
    blade_strike_n = "Blade Strike (n)",
    blade_strike_prob = "Blade Strike Prob",
    blade_strike_prob_ci = "Blade Strike 95% CI"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(shear_prob, collision_prob, blade_strike_prob), decimals = 3) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "-")
```

```{r blade_strike_metric}
# Blade strike comparison table
strike_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(strike_status = ifelse(acc_strike == "Blade strike", "Strike", "No Strike")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(strike_status))

# Get nadir pressure from ROI 4
nadir_pressure <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4") %>%
  select(file, nadir_pres = pres_min.kPa.)

strike_comparison <- strike_data %>%
  left_join(nadir_pressure, by = "file") %>%
  select(strike_status, acc_hig_max.g., nadir_pres, rot_max.degs.) %>%
  gather(metric, value, -strike_status) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(metric, strike_status) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = q3 - q1,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  spread(strike_status, median) %>%
  rename(strike_median = Strike, no_strike_median = `No Strike`) %>%
  # Calculate p-values using Wilcoxon test
  left_join(
    strike_data %>%
      left_join(nadir_pressure, by = "file") %>%
      select(strike_status, acc_hig_max.g., nadir_pres, rot_max.degs.) %>%
      gather(metric, value, -strike_status) %>%
      filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
      group_by(metric) %>%
      summarise(
        p_value = tryCatch({
          wilcox.test(value ~ strike_status)$p.value
        }, error = function(e) NA),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ),
    by = "metric"
  )

strike_comparison %>%
  mutate(
    metric = case_when(
      metric == "acc_hig_max.g." ~ "Max Acceleration (g)",
      metric == "nadir_pres" ~ "Pressure Nadir (kPa)", 
      metric == "rot_max.degs." ~ "Max Rotation (°)"
    )
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Blade Strike vs No Strike Comparison") %>%
  cols_label(
    metric = "Metric",
    strike_median = "Strike Median",
    no_strike_median = "No Strike Median", 
    iqr = "IQR",
    p_value = "P-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(strike_median, no_strike_median, iqr), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 4)
```

# 8. Comprehensive summary statistics

```{r pres_sum}
# Function to read and summarize delineated data
summarize_delineated_data <- function(file_list, data_col, roi_filter = NULL) {
  map_dfr(file_list, function(file) {
    tryCatch({
      data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
      file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
      file_name <- str_remove(file_name, "_delineated")
      
      if (!data_col %in% names(data)) return(NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(roi_filter)) {
        data <- data %>% filter(roi == roi_filter)
      }
      
      data %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[data_col]])) %>%
        summarise(
          file = file_name,
          median_val = median(.data[[data_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
          iqr_val = IQR(.data[[data_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })
}

# Pressure summary statistics by ROI
pres_summary <- all_roi_data %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(
    pres_min_min = min(pres_min.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_min_max = max(pres_min.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_min_med = median(pres_min.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_min_iqr = IQR(pres_min.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_max_min = min(pres_max.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_max_max = max(pres_max.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_max_med = median(pres_max.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    pres_max_iqr = IQR(pres_max.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Get median pressure from delineated files by ROI
if (length(delineated_file_list) > 0) {
  delineated_pres <- map_dfr(c("overall", "roi1_sens_ingress", "roi2_inflow_passage", 
                              "roi3_prenadir", "roi4_nadir", "roi5_postnadir", 
                              "roi6_outflow_passage", "roi7_sens_outgress"), function(roi_val) {
    roi_summary <- summarize_delineated_data(delineated_file_list, "pressure_kpa", roi_val)
    if (nrow(roi_summary) > 0) {
      roi_summary %>%
        summarise(
          roi = roi_val,
          median_from_delineated = median(median_val, na.rm = TRUE),
          iqr_from_delineated = median(iqr_val, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    }
  })
  
  if (nrow(delineated_pres) > 0) {
    pres_summary <- pres_summary %>%
      left_join(delineated_pres, by = "roi")
  }
}

pres_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Pressure Summary Statistics by ROI") %>%
  cols_label(
    roi = "ROI",
    pres_min_min = "Min Pres Min",
    pres_min_max = "Max Pres Min", 
    pres_min_med = "Med Pres Min",
    pres_min_iqr = "IQR Pres Min",
    pres_max_min = "Min Pres Max",
    pres_max_max = "Max Pres Max",
    pres_max_med = "Med Pres Max", 
    pres_max_iqr = "IQR Pres Max"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 2)
```

# 9. Barotrauma assessment

```{r baro_sum}
# Barotrauma summary using overall ROI data and nadir from ROI 4
nadir_data <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4") %>%
  select(file, nadir_pressure = pres_min.kPa.)

baro_data <- merged_data %>%
  left_join(nadir_data, by = "file") %>%
  summarise(
    # Counts
    nadir_baro_count = sum(nadir_baro == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_baro_count = sum(rpc_baro == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_baro_surface_count = sum(lrpc_baro_surface == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_baro_depth_count = sum(lrpc_baro_depth == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for nadir (from ROI 4)
    nadir_min = min(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_max = max(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_med = median(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_iqr = IQR(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for RPC
    rpc_min = min(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_max = max(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_med = median(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_iqr = IQR(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for LRPC surface
    lrpc_surface_min = min(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_max = max(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_med = median(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_iqr = IQR(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for LRPC depth
    lrpc_depth_min = min(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_max = max(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_med = median(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_iqr = IQR(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Transpose for better display
baro_summary_long <- baro_data %>%
  select(nadir_baro_count, nadir_min, nadir_max, nadir_med, nadir_iqr,
         rpc_baro_count, rpc_min, rpc_max, rpc_med, rpc_iqr,
         lrpc_baro_surface_count, lrpc_surface_min, lrpc_surface_max, lrpc_surface_med, lrpc_surface_iqr,
         lrpc_baro_depth_count, lrpc_depth_min, lrpc_depth_max, lrpc_depth_med, lrpc_depth_iqr) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("indicator", "statistic"), sep = "_(?=count|min|max|med|iqr)") %>%
  mutate(
    indicator = case_when(
      str_detect(indicator, "nadir") ~ "Nadir",
      str_detect(indicator, "^rpc") ~ "RPC", 
      str_detect(indicator, "lrpc.*surface") ~ "LRPC Surface",
      str_detect(indicator, "lrpc.*depth") ~ "LRPC Depth"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = indicator, values_from = value)

baro_summary_long %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Barotrauma Indicators Summary") %>%
  cols_label(
    statistic = "Statistic",
    Nadir = "Nadir",
    RPC = "RPC",
    `LRPC Surface` = "LRPC (Surface)",
    `LRPC Depth` = "LRPC (Depth)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 2)
```

```{r baro_proxim}
# Define thresholds
nadir_threshold <- 50  # kPa
rpc_threshold <- 550   # kPa  
lrpc_threshold <- 0.5

# Get nadir data from ROI 4
nadir_threshold_data <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4") %>%
  select(file, nadir_pressure = pres_min.kPa.)

# Calculate proximity to thresholds
proximity_analysis <- merged_data %>%
  left_join(nadir_threshold_data, by = "file") %>%
  summarise(
    # Within 10% of nadir threshold (50 kPa)
    nadir_within_10pct = sum(abs(nadir_pressure - nadir_threshold) <= (nadir_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_total = sum(!is.na(nadir_pressure)),
    
    # Within 10% of RPC threshold (550 kPa)
    rpc_within_10pct = sum(abs(pres_rpc - rpc_threshold) <= (rpc_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_total = sum(!is.na(pres_rpc)),
    
    # Within 10% of LRPC surface threshold (0.5)
    lrpc_surface_within_10pct = sum(abs(pres_lrpc_surface - lrpc_threshold) <= (lrpc_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_total = sum(!is.na(pres_lrpc_surface)),
    
    # Within 10% of LRPC depth threshold (0.5)
    lrpc_depth_within_10pct = sum(abs(pres_lrpc_depth - lrpc_threshold) <= (lrpc_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_total = sum(!is.na(pres_lrpc_depth))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    nadir_pct = round((nadir_within_10pct / nadir_total) * 100, 1),
    rpc_pct = round((rpc_within_10pct / rpc_total) * 100, 1),
    lrpc_surface_pct = round((lrpc_surface_within_10pct / lrpc_surface_total) * 100, 1),
    lrpc_depth_pct = round((lrpc_depth_within_10pct / lrpc_depth_total) * 100, 1)
  )

# Display proximity results
proximity_summary <- tibble(
  Indicator = c("Nadir (50 kPa)", "RPC (550 kPa)", "LRPC Surface (0.5)", "LRPC Depth (0.5)"),
  `Within 10% of Threshold` = c(proximity_analysis$nadir_within_10pct,
                               proximity_analysis$rpc_within_10pct,
                               proximity_analysis$lrpc_surface_within_10pct,
                               proximity_analysis$lrpc_depth_within_10pct),
  `Total Sensors` = c(proximity_analysis$nadir_total,
                     proximity_analysis$rpc_total,
                     proximity_analysis$lrpc_surface_total,
                     proximity_analysis$lrpc_depth_total),
  `Percentage` = c(proximity_analysis$nadir_pct,
                  proximity_analysis$rpc_pct,
                  proximity_analysis$lrpc_surface_pct,
                  proximity_analysis$lrpc_depth_pct)
)

proximity_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Sensors Within 10% of Barotrauma Thresholds") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Percentage, decimals = 1)
```
